classification.difficultyReason: Equate two algebraic rectangle areas, simplify to a quadratic and reject the root incompatible with positive side lengths.

content.prompt: The rectangles shown have equal area. Find the value of $x$.

spec.description: Unshaded left rectangle, taller and narrower than its paired right rectangle; horizontal side 2x−5 and left vertical side x+4. Decorative blue outline becomes house black.
spec.mathematics: Area is (2x-5)(x+4). Physical dimensions are unspecified.

spec.description: Unshaded right rectangle, wider and shorter than its paired left rectangle; horizontal side x+3 and right vertical side x. Decorative blue outline becomes house black.
spec.mathematics: Area is x(x+3). Physical dimensions are unspecified.

answer.worked:
Equal areas give
$$\begin{align*}(2x-5)(x+4)&=x(x+3)\\2x^2+3x-20&=x^2+3x\\x^2-20&=0\\x^2&=20\\x&=\pm\sqrt{20}\\x&=\pm2\sqrt5\end{align*}$$
All side lengths must be positive, so $2x-5>0$, giving $x>\frac52$. Hence $x=2\sqrt5$.
